label: ISR 4331 branch router
description: Sub-2 Gbps branch services router: 100 Mbps of CEF/IPsec forwarding in the base licence, 300 Mbps with the FL-4330-PERF licence and up to 1.8 Gbps with the booster licence. Three onboard dual-mode GE ports (an RJ-45 and an SFP cage on the same port number, one media active at a time) plus a dedicated GE management port, with two NIM slots, one ISC slot and one SM-X slot for WAN, voice and switching modules.
